name: Complete v0.19 kernel backends and CUDA harness
summary: Stages 1, 2, and 3 are locally validated and independently reviewed; RTL equivalence, ESP32, final matrix, hosted CI, sanitizer, and publication work remains.

name: Generated CUDA schedule launchers
summary: Five generated CUDA launchers return full Cl(2,0) roots and validate launch geometry against the active device.

name: Validate generated CUDA launches against active-device limits
summary: Generated launchers preserve zero-count no-op behavior, propagate device-query errors, and reject block or x-grid geometry beyond active-device properties.

name: Keep v0.19 isolated until v0.18.2 is accepted
summary: The v0.19 checkpoint may include the merged hotfix code but must not imply hosted-validation or release-tag completion.

name: v0.19 Stage 1 local validation
summary: Portable GCC/Clang float/double, CUDA 13.1 float/double on RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, and generator suites passed; Compute Sanitizer did not attach.

name: Compute Sanitizer attach timeout
summary: Compute Sanitizer 2025.4 timed out with no attachable process even for a one-kernel probe, so sanitizer coverage is not claimed.

name: GitHub Actions jobs blocked before checkout
summary: Exact-head jobs did not start because of repository-account billing or spending state; repository code never executed.

name: v0.19 hotfix provenance gap
summary: origin/main and v0.19 contain PR #13 merge 0280f0d but not provenance commit 4469433; hosted validation and release tagging remain outstanding.

name: Unified workload benchmark contract
summary: The workload reporter enforces exact CPU and CUDA capability manifests, deterministic configuration, truthful timing scopes, checked byte counts, and required-CUDA semantics.

name: Require exact workload capabilities and timing scopes
summary: Benchmark reports must match exact operation/backend/timing-scope manifests and distinguish public host-end-to-end timing from generated device-kernel timing.

name: v0.19 Stage 2 workload validation
summary: Portable and contract suites passed; CUDA 13.1 float/double each passed 36 executable tests and required-CUDA reports with all 11 capabilities and zero mismatches on RTX 5070 Laptop GPU; hosted Actions and Compute Sanitizer remain unpassed.

name: Fixed GEB-36 typed numerical envelope
summary: All 36 fixed targets have an exact typed manifest, raw-Q deterministic fixtures, decoded-input floating reference, operation-specific LSB budgets, compiled-configuration handshake, and strict complete-sample reporting.

name: Validate fixed GEB-36 with a quantized-input typed envelope
summary: The numerical contract uses the exact 36 target/kind manifest, raw-Q fixtures decoded for the floating reference, complete accounting, compiled precision/Q handshake, deterministic diversity, and explicit LSB budgets.

name: v0.19 Stage 3 fixed GEB-36 validation
summary: Clang ASan/UBSan Q1/8/16/24/30, Python 9/9, MSVC float/double, and GCC double validation passed with complete all-36 reporting and zero failure counts; the shared-primitive oracle and external validation limitations remain explicit.

name: v0.19 Stage 3 initial review failure
summary: Initial review failed because constant-sign and Q1 fixture behavior could produce a degenerate corpus and the reporter trusted requested precision; Q-aware diversity and compiled-precision handshakes resolved both findings before PASS.

name: Add GEO A and B runs to the ESP32-C6 IMU replay benchmark
summary: A floating GEO path and a checked Q16 GEO path are implemented behind the common replay interface; compile and physical-board evidence remain pending.

name: ESP32-C6 GEO A/B/C/D IMU replay benchmark
summary: Four deterministic local orientation paths share one replay, reference, timing boundary, deadline, accuracy schema, hash contract, and heap reporting surface.

name: Represent quaternions as paired Cl(2,0) complex-matrix components
summary: Map q=w+xi+yj+zk to A+iB with A=w+y e12 and B=x e1+z e2, so each quaternion product is four existing Cl(2,0) products.

name: ESP32 IMU A/B startup agreement check
summary: A 512-step deterministic fixture requires finite A/B/C output, zero B arithmetic failures, A/C agreement within 0.01 degrees, and B/C agreement within 1 degree.
